routing.finaliserQuery:
UPDATE ai_conversation_state
SET
    intent = NULL,
    service = NULL,
    site = NULL,
    date_debut = NULL,
    date_fin = NULL,
    slot_id = NULL,
    new_slot_id = NULL,
    available_slots = NULL,
    selected_slot_index = NULL,

    pending_action = NULL,
    conversation_step = NULL,

    nom = NULL,
    prenom = NULL,
    email = NULL,
    telephone = NULL,

    reference = NULLIF($2::text, ''),
    token = NULLIF($3::text, ''),

    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'

WHERE session_id = $1

RETURNING *;
routing.finaliserReplacement: ={{ $('Lorsqu\'un message de chat est reçu').item.json.sessionId }},{{ $('Paramètres clôture confirmation').item.json.appointmentReference || '' }},{{ (($('Paramètres clôture confirmation').item.json.appointment || {}).token_gestion || ($('Paramètres clôture confirmation').item.json.appointment || {}).token || '') }}

notes: Lire tentative includes CONFIRMED → openAttempt status CONFIRMED with reference.
RECALL → Réponse référence déjà connue: ack with reference; no CLAIM/POST; does not finalize session.
Non-AFFIRM on CONFIRMED → COLLECT → Aiguiller fallback → Valider paramètres création (ready=claimAcquired only; no CreateAppointment).
Session remains AWAIT_CREATE_CONFIRMATION until explicit RECONCILE_CONFIRMED_SESSION.
